turns.prompt_text: what is alkaline water and why do people drink
turns.response_html:
Alkaline water has a higher pH level than regular tap water, typically ranging from 8 to 9. It contains basic minerals like calcium, magnesium, and potassium, which neutralize acidity.

People drink it because they believe it can:

  • Neutralize acid in the bloodstream.
  • Improve metabolism and increase energy.
  • Slow aging through antioxidant properties.
  • Enhance hydration via smaller molecular clusters.

Scientific evidence for these health claims is limited, as the human body naturally maintains its own pH balance through the kidneys and lungs.

turns.prompt_text: so why does Gatorade sell their own now and everyone in body armor in everyone has their own alkaline water at this point
turns.response_html:
Gatorade and BodyArmor are moving into the $25 billion water market to capture "active consumers" who want hydration without the high sugar and neon dyes of traditional sports drinks.

By selling alkaline water, these brands can:

  • Command higher prices through "premium" health branding.
  • Target all-day use rather than just during intense workouts.
  • Compete with "clean" brands like Essentia that have gained massive market share.

While the science is thin, the marketing works: it keeps legacy brands relevant to a more health-conscious, sugar-avoidant generation.
